title: OpenACC I: directives, parallel loops, and data management
status: reviewed and locally validated; independent round 2 ACCEPT
transcript_provenance: Local machine transcription (faster-whisper small.en); not publisher captions
source_uncertainties: No source audio was independently audited. Corrections refer to inspected slide content and documented semantics, not claims that particular words were spoken. Machine transcription spellings are not quoted in the reader chapter.

The course-era platform list and PGI compiler examples are historical lecture material; no current support-matrix or locally installed NVIDIA compiler claim is inferred. No nvc was found on the inspected Linux PATH.

OpenACC3.3 is the semantics reference; GCC13.3 preprocessing reports _OPENACC201711. Only the printed feature subset was executed. Array/subarray reductions and arbitrary object-graph copying were not tested.

Version-specific GCC13.3 libgomp web paths returned inaccessible; the opened current GNU manual is used only for activation/backend statements independently corroborated by installed inspection and finite execution.
No GPU timings or speedup measurements were performed. Transfer bandwidth10GB/s and0.5s unchanged work are explicitly hypothetical model inputs.
Framef0028 of source52 is black and f0032 of source54 is a title transition; they are recorded as viewed but supply no code claim.
Section timestamps are automatic-transcript topic anchors within recording durations.

Default-target final-check attempt failed at compilation, not runtime, because assembler selected through checker PATH rejected sm_50. The repaired explicit sm_80 contracts were freshly checked; no timing from the old build is used.
